title: BLR acceptance probability in ±1 form
statement:
Let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ be a Boolean-valued function, and write $F(x) = (-1)^{f(x)} \in \{\pm 1\}$ for its sign lift. Then the BLR acceptance probability of $f$, the probability that $F(x \oplus y) = F(x)\,F(y)$ when $x$ and $y$ are drawn independently and uniformly from $\{0,1\}^n$, satisfies
\[
  \Pr_{x,y}[\text{BLR accepts}]
  \;=\;
  \frac{1 + \E_{x}\!\left[\E_{y}\!\left[ F(x)\,F(y)\,F(x \oplus y) \right]\right]}{2},
\]
where $x \oplus y$ denotes the componentwise XOR.
hypotheses_covered: f is a Boolean-valued function on the n-dimensional hypercube
